# `.xlsx` comparison fixtures

Each directory is one case: `old.xlsx` and `new.xlsx`, real workbooks read
through the real `sheets-diff` parser by the tests in `src/xlsx.rs`. The test
`every_fixture_pair_renders_two_different_sides_in_both_directions` walks this
directory, so a new case is covered without registering it.

**Generated by `cargo xtask xlsx-fixtures`** (F134), tracked at
`xtask/src/xlsx_fixtures.rs`, using `rust_xlsxwriter` 0.99.0 (pinned exactly
in `xtask/Cargo.toml`, not a caret range, so a patch bump cannot change what
it writes without that being a deliberate, reviewed edit) with a fixed
creation timestamp (2026-09-26), so running it again reproduces every file
below. `cargo xtask xlsx-fixtures --check` verifies the committed files are
exactly what the generator currently produces, and fails naming whichever
case drifted.

This replaces an earlier version of this README's claim, which named a
"throwaway program" that was never tracked — that program no longer exists,
if it ever existed outside whoever wrote it, and the claim could not be
checked. Regenerating under the tracked program here did not reproduce the
previously-committed files byte-for-byte (nothing records the original
program's exact calls), so the files below were replaced with this
generator's output; every case was re-verified against `src/xlsx.rs`'s own
test assertions first, which is the actual ground truth for each case's
shape — the generator was written to match *that*, not to guess at lost
bytes. The crate's full test suite, and specifically every `xlsx::tests::*`
test, passes unchanged against the replacement files.

Sheets and cells:

| case | old | new |
|---|---|---|
| `basic` | `Sheet1`: A1 "hello" | A1 "world" |
| `unchanged_sheet` | `Same` (A1 "same"), `Changed` (A1 "before") | `Same` untouched, `Changed` A1 "after" |
| `renamed` | `Original` (A1 "same") | `Renamed` (A1 "same") — name only, same tab position |
| `renamed_and_moved` | `Anchor` (tab 1, A1 "a"), `ToRename` (tab 2, A1 "r") | `RenamedSheet` (tab 1, A1 "r"), `Anchor` (tab 2, A1 "a") — `ToRename` renamed *and* moved, collapsing to a single `Renamed` entry; `Anchor` only moves |
| `formula` | `Sheet1`: A1 formula `1+1`, no cached result | A1 formula `2+2`, no cached result |
| `formula_cached_value_changed` (F138) | `Sheet1`: A1 `1`, A2 `1`, A3 formula `A1+A2` cached result `2` | same formula text, cached result `3` |
| `large` | `Sheet1`: 51,000 numeric cells, A1..A51000 | byte-identical copy of `old.xlsx` — sizes the bounds and is cancelled; its rendered sides are correctly equal |
| `reorder_only` | `Same` (A1 "unchanged content"), `Other` (A1 "other content") | the same two sheets, tabs swapped |
| `sheet_added` | `Kept` (A1 "same") | `Kept`, `Added` (A1 "other content") |
| `sheet_removed` | `Kept` (A1 "same"), `Removed` (A1 "other content") | `Kept` |
| `chart_sheet_not_compared` | `Data` (A1 "before", A2 1) and chart sheet `Chart1` | the same with A1 "after" |
| `ambiguous_rename` | `Alpha` (A1 "alpha"), `Beta` (A1 "beta") | `Gamma` (A1 "gamma"), `Delta` (A1 "delta") — two removed, two added, none matchable |
| `duplicate_row_keys` | `Keyed`: column A `k`, `k`, `x`; column B one, two, three | the same with "TWO" (a duplicate key; only a keyed alignment reports it) |
| `stray_far_cell` (F123, F130) | `Data`: A1 "origin" and XFD1048576 "x" | the same with "y" |

`large`'s byte-identical pair is produced by writing one workbook and copying
the file, rather than generating twice — two separately-generated-but
-equivalent files are not guaranteed byte-identical, and
`every_fixture_pair_renders_two_different_sides_in_both_directions` decides
"the workbooks differ" from the files' raw bytes, not their parsed content.
